title: Authenticate selected control children and retain runner custody
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Authenticate the actual child selected by the existing native acquisition controls, backport the retained-child repair into their original runner, and retain the supervisor's process and capture custody through failure. This is a completed scoped source archive with 17 owning sources, constructive arguments, a separate exact-source AI review, and preserved earlier drafts.

The child constructor binds the actual 42-module selection for the existing `ENOENT`, `EEXIST` and `ELOOP` cases. The runner retains child identity before signalling and consuming its wait. The supervisor separates observational handles from direct-child retirement authority, keeps incomplete custody pending, and attempts available readback of four streams before formatting errors.

This continues [the original investigation #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321) and [the acquisition/family source contribution #6882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6882). Complete fault delivery, historical continuation compatibility, the full control union, runtime qualification, resource fit and measured comparison remain open. No multiplication-bound or measured speedup claim is made.

## Task and overlap

Explicit assigned verification/data-handling work, based on upstream `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The archive README gives exact refreshed heads and reuse decisions for #6882, #6867, #6869, #6873, #6588, #6339, #6346 and #6347. It adapts existing repairs to the actual older control runner and actual selected child. The accepted scientific entry is a separate subject.

The scope is refined to this completed connected correction. The component driver explicitly interprets the existing authenticated command tail as a canonical immutable preparation pin; the actual command grant must cover that tail. Original Root forwarding, scientific lane semantics, physical caps and native/accounting namespaces are preserved.

## Validation

Exact retrieval verified nine plaintext JSON shards, 101 retained records, all certificate and final-review pins, and the complete 42-module source reference set. Publication checks are `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-ARCHIVE.txt` and the original frozen checksum list. Source, independent review, certificate and export freezes precede the fixed source/review deadline; later collection/publication and the roughly 84-second reassessment gap are explicit.

Target imports, native/control/compiler/scientific execution and unchanged control reruns were not performed. This inert archive has no registered replay hook. The independent review is AI source review, not human, proof-kernel or maintainer approval. Full costs and current execution admission remain unresolved; unknown physical/outside costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`.

## Credit

Clear1nsight with substantial ChatGPT Pro and OpenAI Codex assistance. Retain predecessor and parallel credit, including unpaidmoon's #6339 cleanup work, the later #6867/#6873 ownership repairs, and all original source notices under the repository license.

## Open next questions

Start with the archived historical continuation counterexamples and authentic-fault route analysis. Complete the missing production fault deliveries and genuine continuation mappings, then the complete scenario/command/cost union. Whole-source acceptance precedes admitted execution and comparison. See the package README and [maintained upstream overview](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045) for concrete contribution tasks.
